key_insight: Deterministically optimized twirling sequences shape coherent-error trajectories through destructive interference, keeping accumulated error bounded without logical encoding or ancillary qubits.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects digital circuit compilation with pulse-level robust control to improve quantum hardware resilience before fault tolerance.
method: Extend pulse-level geometric error analysis to discrete quantum circuits.
Map coherent-error accumulation to trajectories in a high-dimensional error space.
Optimize twirling sequences to shape trajectories and combine them with robust control pulses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports bounded O(1) accumulated-error scaling versus O(√N) for randomized compiling, but provides no numerical benchmarks or hardware-validation details.
watch_item: Performance under realistic mixed noise and the optimization cost of constructing twirling sequences remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: Bridging Pulse and Circuit Levels: A Geometric Framework for Deterministic Error Suppression
